title: A Beautiful Mess: Weavers and Knotters of the Vanguard
description: Organized by Bedford Gallery, A Beautiful Mess: Weavers & Knotters of the Vanguard brought together eleven women artists exploring the expressive and sculptural possibilities of fiber-based practices. Through weaving, knotting, and the manipulation of unconventional materials, the exhibition challenged traditional distinctions between craft and fine art, addressing themes of identity, memory, and social transformation. Working with industrial cordage and intricate weaving techniques, I construct sculptural forms that explore tension, accumulation, and the relationship between material and structure. Together, the works reconsider the cultural significance of textile practices, transforming familiar materials into powerful expressions of personal and collective experience.
